observation: Fresh main materializes authority facets with an unanchored regex. A comment containing a facet-shaped lookalike before the real declaration can absorb the replacement, leaving the executable facet unchanged. In a configurable policy this can make the recorded authority context disagree with the RCL source actually executed and can preserve a permissive executable facet when a restrictive mode was requested.
